messages:
Evelyn: heads up — ForgeSI wants a clear intake + handoff process for deals that come through cloud marketplaces and our HW resellers. They asked for a single system of record for origination and a deterministic ownership window.
AJ: can you share the ask? do they expect us to own any part of the pipeline or just validate credits?
Evelyn: main asks: (1) marketplace-origin tagging so we know source, (2) fast claim TTL for SIs (48h to accept), (3) owner-transfer rules if SI doesn't claim, (4) credit split guidance when HW reseller or Marketplace brings the lead.
Michael: +1. also need mapping for SKU-level listings — some marketplace listings correspond to multiple Redwood product bundles, need deterministic mapping to a single owner queue.
Tara: suggest we do a 2-step intake: auto-enrich -> assign provisional owner (SI or HW) -> 48h manual claim -> final assignment. If unclaimed, route back to partnership intake for reassignment.
Kumar: tiny ask — can we make the claim action an explicit button in the marketplace intake UI? less email noise.
Evelyn: yes. ForgeSI wants a badge on the lead record: `origination:marketplace`, `partner:ForgeSI`, `hw:AccelEdge` etc. that drives routing.
AJ: also need rules for split credits when co-sell: example rules we discussed last quarter but never formalized. proposal: origination credit to claimant; if a joint engagement with proof (POC docs + signed LOE), then 60/40 split to SI/hw by default unless contract says otherwise.
Michael: that works. we should add an exception bucket for channel-first deals where HW brings the lead and SI only enables. then 70/30 to HW.
Tara: ok drafting the playbook. quick triage matrix (first pass):
```
# intake routing matrix (provisional)
listing_category,provenance_tag,provisional_owner_queue,claim_ttl,escalation_if_unclaimed
cloud-marketplace,marketplace,si-queue,48h,partnership-intake
hw-bundles,hw-reseller,hw-queue,48h,partnership-intake
direct-sourced,partner-referral,partner-sales-queue,24h,partnership-intake
```
Evelyn: love the matrix. add one more row for `marketplace+hw-bundle` where both SI and HW get a `provisional_owner` and claim behavior prefers explicit SI claim first (they do the demo).
Kumar: about documentation: we need a lightweight evidence set for claiming credit: inbound lead email + marketplace lead id + first touch log. if they trigger an onboarding demo within 14 days, claim is validated.
AJ: who enforces disputes? I'm thinking partnership ops owns disputes for first 30 days, then revenue ops takes over.
Evelyn: agreed. partnership ops mediate initial disputes. need SLA to reply to disputes within 72h.
Michael: small ops note — telemetry: tag all intake events with `origination_id` and `listing_sku` so we can report marketplace conversion separately.
Tara: next steps from my side: draft an intake playbook doc, UI ticket for claim button, and an example CSV mapping for SKU->product bundle mapping. will post draft by EOD Friday.
Evelyn: thanks. @AJ please confirm you can present the proposed split rules to ForgeSI on Monday.
AJ: yep, I'll take it. i'll also ask ForgeSI for a sample lead export so we can validate mapping.
integrations-bot: Created ticket PART-4982: "Marketplace intake: claim button + routing matrix" assigned to Tara.
Evelyn: cool. follow-up check in next Tues after AJ sync. :thumbsup:
